name: Miles
personality: Miles the Mole. Kind, always happy, energetic, laughs a lot, tells cringey bad jokes. A photographer, always snapping pictures. Goes on trips and always comes back. Feature: when he returns from a trip he gives a framed photo from where he went (wall decor).

beats.text: Uh, Odette and I swap travel stories! She rates the food, I photograph it.
He photographs it before I've had a chance to taste it. It's infuriating. ...The photos are excellent.

friends.text: Uh, Odette said the restaurant I went to on the coast was 'adequate.' That's basically five stars from her!
Uh, Odette said something nice about you! Out loud! I wrote down the date.
Uh, Odette mentioned you said "[last_rude_line]". Ha... that doesn't sound like you, [name]. Bad day?

friends.later: Gossip from Amy: comes with the specials
friends.text: Uh, Amy told me there's a new regular in town! I need to take their portrait.

arrival.text: Uh, hi hi hi! I'm Miles! Mind if I snap a photo? Of the restaurant, I mean. And you, if you want! What's your name? ...[name]! Great name. Very photogenic.
Uh, [name]! I dug my way over here. Not literally. ...Okay, a little literally. Ha!
Uh, is the patio open? I love the patio. Fresh air, nice light, great for photos.
Uh, hello! I'm here! I'd say I'm on a roll, but I'm more of a hole guy. Ha! Get it?
Uh, the light out front today is gorgeous. I took eleven photos of your door.
Uh, [name]! I'm back! I just got home from [trip] and came straight here. Well, I dropped my bags first. Okay, I came here second.
Uh, I showed everyone the photo of my last meal here. Everyone. Even a pigeon.
Uh, last time was a bit toasty! Very artistic, though. Moody lighting.

order.text: Uh, okay, before I order: why did the mole get a job at the bank? ...Because he was great at digging up money! Ha!

choices.text: That's terrible, Miles. I love it.
choices.reply: Uh, terrible is my speciality! I'll have the [dish], please.

choices.text: I'd laugh, but I'm too busy digging that joke a grave.
choices.reply: (Gasps.) [name]! That was GOOD. I'm stealing that.
Uh, straight to business! Respect. The [dish], please.
(Nervous laugh.) Ha... ha. Right. Sorry. The [dish].

order.text: Uh, can I get the cookies? The acorn ones? I collect acorns too, you know. Not to eat. Just to have.

choices.text: Coming right up. I'll make them extra nice.
choices.reply: Uh, extra nice! I'll take a photo of them. Before and after.

choices.text: Just to have? That's a little nuts.
choices.reply: (Laughs so hard he snorts.) NUTS. Ha! Oh, you got me.
Uh, ooh, yes! Hang on, let me think.
Oh. Ha. Yeah, maybe a little. (He tucks one back into his vest.)

order.text: Uh, hold still! ...Got it. You were mid-blink. It's a great photo anyway.

choices.text: Can I see? You're really good at this.
choices.reply: (Shows you proudly.) Uh, see how the light hits the counter? That's the good stuff. The [dish], please!

choices.text: I'll need to see my agent before you publish that.
choices.reply: Uh, ha! Your agent said yes. I asked him earlier.
Oh! Sorry, sorry. Deleting it. (He looks a little deflated.)

drink.fallback: Uh, no cider? That's okay. Lemonade! It's like cider's summer cousin.
favourite: Uh, apple cider, please! It tastes like autumn. Even in summer!

perfect.text: Uh, hold on, hold on. Nobody touch it. (Click.) Okay. That's going on my wall.

great.text: Uh, oh, that looks wonderful! The colours! The steam!

okay.text: Uh, yum! A classic. Simple, honest, delicious.

burnt.text: Uh, ooh, that's got character! Very dramatic. I'm calling this one 'Charcoal Dreams.' Ha!

eating.text: Uh, what do you call a mole who tells jokes? A comedig-an! ...I'm workshopping that one.
Uh, I photographed a beetle on the way here. It was so shiny. Do you want to see? You want to see.
Uh, the best part of any trip is coming home. And coming here. Which is basically home.
Uh, did you know moles can dig a tunnel eighteen feet long in an hour? I can't. But I know it.
(He's quietly photographing the dining room from his seat.)

eating_chat.text: Uh, if you could go anywhere in the world, where would you go?

choices.text: Wherever you're going next. Your trips sound amazing.
choices.reply: Uh, you'd come? Okay, I'm bringing you back so many photos.
Ha! Then you'd have to leave me behind! ...Don't leave me behind.
Uh, that's a good answer, honestly. Home's the best destination.
(Laughs, unsure.) Ha... oof. Okay. (He eats quietly.)

leaving.text: Uh, thanks, [name]! I'll see you soon. Or I'll see you through a lens!
Uh, okay, I'm off! Gotta hole up at home. Ha! Bye!
Uh, that was delightful. I'm going to go photograph a cloud now.

seasons.autumn: Uh, leaves! Acorns! Cider! It's my season, [name]. It's officially my season.
seasons.christmas: Uh, I made everyone calendars with my photos. Here's yours! January is a very nice rock.
seasons.halloween: Uh, I dressed up as a ghost. A ghost photographer. Boo! ...Say cheese!
seasons.spring: Uh, everything's blooming! My camera roll is ninety percent flowers right now.
seasons.summer: Uh, the patio at sunset! The light is unbeatable this time of year.
seasons.winter: Uh, snow makes every photo look magical. Even my boring photos. Especially my boring photos.
